summary: template options: owner, SELinux context fields, the required src template on the controller (UTF-8), and trim_blocks (true) which removes the newline after block tags.
questions: Where does the template module look for the src file?
Why are newlines after my {% if %} tags removed?
How do I set an SELinux type on a templated file?

answer_card.title: template src, owner, trim_blocks
answer_card.answer_md:
- `src` (required): Jinja2 template on the **controller**, UTF-8
- `trim_blocks` (true): removes first newline after a block tag (not variable tags)
- `owner`, `seuser`/`serole`/`setype`/`selevel`
